description: IAM: Entra ID accounts for the people who work on Novatrix's environment -- two of the staff and two externals, each on a separate purpose account, never their own -- least-privilege RBAC on the resource group through groups, and a managed identity prepared for the storage env.

userAssigned.description: The errand form's identity. Deliberately given no permissions this env -- v37 grants it write access to exactly one blob container.

assignments.justification: Operations must start, stop, resize and rebuild the VM. It stops short of Contributor, so they cannot alter the network or hand out roles.
Developers need to see the environment to diagnose the application. They change it through the pipeline, never by hand, so read is all they need.
A security review reads the environment and changes nothing. Read is all it gets, and the account has a date.
